_comment: Display-only literature-anchored unit translations (roadmap Phase 5). Statements scale with the LEVER percent (real kr per pupil), using the cited studies' own dose-response figures. They NEVER read the simulator's unitless deltas - that would violate the Q3 decision (no calibrated coefficients). All money in DKK: foreign studies contribute percentage effects only, applied to Danish kr baselines. Consumed by js/cascade-translate.js.
_gate: Translations render only within |lever change| <= gate_abs_pct. The cited studies cover roughly 10-25% spending variation; extrapolating to the +/-100% bookends is not supported.

baselines.income_source: DST INDKP101 latest value, read live from the loaded dataset (not baked here)

chain: Jackson, Johnson & Persico (2016): +10% per-pupil spending sustained through all school years -> ~7% higher adult wages (9.6% for low-income pupils). US quasi-experimental (court-ordered finance reforms).
income.geography_flag: Based on American school-funding reforms (Jackson, Johnson & Persico 2016). No Danish folkeskole study exists; the one Danish causal study (gymnasium level) found no effect.
income.lag_display: 15 to 30 years, when today's pupils are grown

chain: Hyman (2016): +10% per-pupil spending -> +3-5pp upper-secondary completion (US, Michigan IV).
OECD Education at a Glance 2024, Denmark 2023: employment rate 62% (below upper-secondary) vs 82% (upper secondary) - a 20pp gap.
unemployment.geography_flag: Based on US school-funding studies (Hyman 2016) combined with OECD's employment figures for Denmark (Education at a Glance 2024). Chaining two studies compounds uncertainty - shown as a range.
unemployment.lag_display: when today's pupils reach working age

chain: OECD Gallup 0-10 ladder: full-time employed report 6.5 vs 6.1 for those outside work - ~0.4 points per person moved into employment.
OECD Gallup 0-10 ladder: richest 20% report 6.4 vs 5.8 for poorest 20%; via a log-income gradient, +7% income -> ~0.04 points cohort-wide.
life_satisfaction.geography_flag: OECD Gallup surveys across many countries, not Danish-specific.
life_satisfaction.units_caveat: Adult life satisfaction on the 0-10 Cantril ladder - NOT the pupil-wellbeing series (1-5 scale) charted for this node.
life_satisfaction.lag_display: follows the income and employment effects (15-30 years)
